# Skill: Portugol

Use when the task involves **writing, editing, or understanding Portugol code** (`.por` files). Portugol is a Portuguese-based educational programming language used in Brazilian CS courses, developed by UNIVALI/LITE.

This skill is based on the official documentation and examples from **Portugol Studio** (https://github.com/UNIVALI-LITE/Portugol-Studio).

## When to use

- Writing or editing `.por` algorithm files
- Understanding Portugol syntax, types, control structures
- Creating educational programming exercises in Portugol
- Debugging Portugol code

## Contents

Full reference in `REFERENCE.md` covering syntax, types, declarations, I/O, expressions, control flow, and libraries — all with official example code.
